item.title: Doctors impregnated wife with another man's semen, lawsuit claims
item.description: A couple that turned to fertility treatments 44 years ago claims that doctors inseminated the woman with semen from another individual instead of her husband’s, according to a recent lawsuit filed against Oregon Health and Science University and its affiliate, Providence Health. #fertilitytreatments #IVF #insemination #infertility #lawsuit

item.title: Indonesian church celebrates Christmas despite pressure to cancel service
item.description: A pastor came under pressure from local Muslims in Indonesia on Christmas Eve to announce that Christmas services were cancelled even though his church won approval to hold the celebrations, sources said. #Indonesia #persecution #IndonesianEvangelicalMissionChurch

item.title: Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson shares Scripture in New Year's message
item.description: New England Patriots rookie running back TreVeyon Henderson has shared Scripture with his fans in a message posted just before New Year’s Day 2026. #NationalFootballLeague #NewEnglandPatriots #TreVeyonHenderson #X

item.title: Zohran Mamdani becomes first NYC mayor sworn in on Quran: 'Highly symbolic'
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani was sworn into office by New York Attorney General Letitia James during a midnight ceremony on Thursday morning at the decommissioned Old City Hall Station. #ZohranMamdani #NewYorkCity #Quran #Islam #politics

item.title: Australian school exposed students to 'disturbing' sexually explicit content without parental consent, mom says
item.description: An Australian mother is weighing legal action after her teenage daughter was exposed to explicit sexual content — including references to bestiality and sibling sex — during a school lesson delivered without parental knowledge or consent, according to a Christian legal advocacy group. #Australia #ParentalRights #Porn #Sex

item.title: Charlie Kirk murder suspect seeks independent prosecutor; defense alleges 'conflict of interest'
item.description: Tyler Robinson’s defense team is challenging the Utah County Attorney’s office's involvement in the criminal case against Charlie Kirk’s alleged killer because a relative of one of the prosecutors was present at the event where the conservative activist was assassinated. #CharlieKirkassassination #TylerRobinson #TPUSA #criminaltrial

item.title: Virginia school board bans compelled use of trans pronouns
item.description: A major school district in Virginia has adopted new policies to prevent the forced use of trans-identified students’ and teachers’ chosen pronouns, as teachers and students in districts across the United States have faced repercussions for referring to individuals using names and pronouns that match their sex. #Virginia #Education #LGBT #Transgender

item.title: Talking is a 'miracle': 3 highlights from Dennis Prager's interview after spinal cord injury
item.description: Conservative radio host and writer Dennis Prager shared an update about his health following an accident that led to a spinal cord injury and paralyzation, saying recently that maintaining a sense of gratitude has helped him during a time of suffering. #DennisPrager #PragerU #Israel #spinalcordinjury #spiritualreflection

item.title: Award-winning singer who 'changed the face of black gospel music' dies at 77
item.description: Award-winning gospel singer Richard Smallwood has died at the age of 77, leaving behind a legacy that “clearly and solidly changed the face of black gospel music.” #RichardSmallwood #Gospelmusic #HowardUniversity

item.title: Iranian protesters facing violence, intimidation as economy deteriorates; US 'deeply concerned'
item.description: Protesters in Iran have taken to the streets as the country’s economy deteriorates, with the U.S. State Department expressing concern about the use of violent force against peaceful demonstrators. #Iran #Iranianprotesters #StateDepartment #Trumpadministration
